citation.author: Rod Cross
citation.title: Oblique bounce of a rubber ball

specimen.inertia_status: homogeneous solid sphere assumption; not separately measured

extraction.method: Manual review of original 706x1036 publisher figure; 3x3 color-mask erosion helped locate filled dots. Pixel centers are retained. Thin fit curves are excluded. Marker identification is not based on agreement with a model.
extraction.angle_definition: degrees above the surface tangent; 90 is normal incidence
extraction.selection: 13 oblique impacts with distinguishable markers and panel associations, plus two normal restitution impacts. Dense overlapping groups near 14,18-23,49-61 degrees omitted because their pairing is ambiguous. The 16-degree case is sufficiently isolated in horizontal order.
extraction.holdout_rule: Four cases reserved before any model fitting: P5-03 (~29 deg), P5-07 (~43 deg), P5-11 (~69 deg), P5-15 (90 deg). Never include these in parameter fitting.
limitations: No per-trial dimensional incident speed is published in this figure. Reconstruct only dimensionless speeds/spins; do not assign exact raw incident velocities.
The omega1 estimate is algebraically derived from three digitized observables and is uncertain; it is not a raw video measurement. Retain the author incident-spin bound.
Two normal-incidence points constrain restitution only; tangential ratios are undefined there.
Panel associations may be revisited only with visual evidence, never to improve a model score.

observations.pairing: Common incidence angle across panels a, c, d; close adjacent markers kept in their observed horizontal order. Cross-panel association is inferred, not an author supplied trial ID.
